text:
"What's your rate?"

Every interior designer gets this message. Then the client disappears.

The problem isn't the rate. The client doesn't know their own budget yet, so any single number scares them.

Give them a range instead. A simple cost estimator on the website:
→ Flat size (2BHK / 3BHK)
→ Scope (kitchen, wardrobes, full home)
→ Finish (basic / premium)
→ Instant ₹ range, then a PDF estimate for their WhatsApp number

What changes: fewer 20-minute calls with people far outside your budget, and leads who arrive already knowing roughly what it costs.

We build these calculators. Comment "CALC" and I'll share an idea for one in your business.
